title: AOF 重写(rewrite)：抵消冗余写命令
expected_output:
AOF 重写(rewrite):
  重写前命令数: 5 [('SET', 'a', 1), ('SET', 'a', 2), ('SET', 'b', 1), ('SET', 'a', 3), ('SET', 'c', 9)]
  重写后命令数: 3 [('SET', 'a', 3), ('SET', 'b', 1), ('SET', 'c', 9)]
  效果: 抵消冗余写命令, AOF 体积大幅缩小, 恢复时间变短
code:
def aof_rewrite(commands):
    latest = {}
    for op, k, v in commands:
        latest[k] = v  # 重放后每个 key 只保留最终值
    return [("SET", k, v) for k, v in latest.items()]

cmds = [("SET", "a", 1), ("SET", "a", 2), ("SET", "b", 1), ("SET", "a", 3), ("SET", "c", 9)]
before = len(cmds)
rew = aof_rewrite(cmds)
print("AOF 重写(rewrite):")
print("  重写前命令数:", before, cmds)
print("  重写后命令数:", len(rew), rew)
print("  效果: 抵消冗余写命令, AOF 体积大幅缩小, 恢复时间变短")
